features.title: Web search settings
features.summary: The native Web search plugin page (provider switch, endpoint, limits and API key) from one owned fork of the stock row. Behaviour is the native one; the credential state behind the key field is read while the page shows, once per burst of settings changes.
failureModes: A refused credential read keeps the last answer for the reference in force, as natively.
A settings or credential change while the page is hidden marks it stale; showing it reads the credential once.

externalDependencies.boundary: configForms serves the web, web-search-deepseek and web-deepseek-api sections the page edits.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Focused tests drive typed section fakes; the scratch journey uses the real settings shell.

telemetry.reason: Client-only fork: it calls native credentials and settings Remote methods whose Host spans belong to core.
